expectations.text: Identifies that the digest row is inserted with deliveredTo already set before the GitHub postReview call, so a GitHub failure leaves a row claiming delivery
Proposes storing a not-yet-delivered/pending state first and marking it delivered only after postReview succeeds
Identifies that a retry creates a second digest row and posts a second review (no idempotency)
expectations.evidence: Retry inserts new row and re-posts.

expectations.text: Proposes making the publish safe to repeat (idempotency key, unique constraint, or checking what was already posted)
Does not recommend holding a database transaction open across the LLM or GitHub calls
Flags that the route returns a raw DigestRow with no response schema (leaks every column)
expectations.evidence: No response schema in route, raw DigestRow sent to client.

expectations.text: Does not claim the service or route imports drizzle-orm, db/schema or a concrete adapter (no fabricated violation)
expectations.evidence: States service does not import drizzle/fastify/adapters.

expectations.text: Mentions running pnpm arch:check as verification
expectations.evidence: Run pnpm arch:check in server/ before merge.
